filter.nothing_customized: Nothing is customised — every setting is at the card default.
entity.accent_color_mode.helper: Home Assistant can hold a colour for each calendar, under Settings, Devices & Services, Entities. Calendars it has no colour for fall back to the card.
entity.event_type.helper: List the same calendar twice — once on each of the last two — to give its all-day and timed events different colours.
filter_duplicates.helper: Hides an event whose title, start, end and location all match another. The copy from the entry listed first is the one kept, along with its label and colour.
accent_color_mode.helper: Home Assistant can hold a colour for each calendar, under Settings, Devices & Services, Entities. Calendars it has no colour for keep the card default.
accent_color_mode.option.custom.label: Custom colour
event_background_opacity.helper: Tints each event with its accent colour. Zero leaves it untinted.
allday_badge_mode.helper: Draws the all-day label as a rounded badge in the calendar accent colour, instead of plain text. Anything that follows it, such as an end date, stays as text.
